la1-morada: Moved flat in Portugal? Most people update their address four times.
With a Portuguese citizen card, you only need to do it once.
Change it on the card itself, online or at a counter.
That one change goes to the tax office, Social Security and the health service. Automatically.
You'll get a letter with a code. Until you enter it, the change doesn't count.
You have sixty days. Still separate: your car registration, and your pet's registry.
la2-renda: Paying rent in cash, with no receipt? You could be losing up to nine hundred euros.
Your landlord has to give you rent receipts. Most must issue them on the tax portal.
The lease itself must be registered with the tax office, by the end of the month after it starts.
Tenants get fifteen percent of their rent back on IRS. Up to nine hundred euros for 2026.
No receipts, no deduction. So ask for them.
la3-sns: Got your S N S health number? It might not cover you yet.
Any foreign resident can get one, at their first visit to a health centre or hospital.
But the health service only covers your costs when the number is linked to four things.
Your I D. Your NIF. Your Portuguese address. And your residence permit.
Missing one? Sort it out before you need a doctor, not after.
